title: Racer Direct Zipf | 512 x 512 MiB
description: Balanced-config experiment: 512 x 536870912-byte blobs, seed zipf-balanced-v1, Zipf exponent 0.5, owned-only disk retention (admission disabled), 4 GiB plaintext, 8 GiB ciphertext, and 2 GiB each for dirty and registered buffers. Balanced describes the configuration goal, not measured hit shares. Wait a full five-minute new-pod window after rollout; historical 64 MiB samples are invalid under this multiplier. Successful payload is not wire traffic or verified goodput. Cache-hit event shares are not client attribution.

panels.title: Total successful client payload (Gbit/s)
panels.description: Successful generic blob operations times exactly 536870912 bytes (512 MiB). Catalog: 512 blobs, seed zipf-balanced-v1, Zipf exponent 0.5. Includes only completed successes, with or without client hashing. Not wire traffic. Wait until all new pods are ready and the full five-minute window excludes old 64 MiB pod samples. Mixed workloads or historical old-size intervals invalidate this calculation.

panels.title: Successful payload per discovered Racer node (Gbit/s)
panels.description: Total successful client payload divided by distinct nodes with discovered Racer dataplane scrape targets, including down targets. Removed targets disappear; this is not expected fleet inventory or per-server traffic attribution. No traffic, missing scrapes, and missing discovery must be checked separately.

panels.title: Observed cache-hit event mix (not client attribution)
panels.description: Each event rate divided by memory + disk + peer hit event rates. These are shares of observed cache-hit events, not client hit probabilities, byte shares, or lookup hit ratios. Origin fills are excluded. Peer reception and memory/disk serving can count the same page on different nodes; coalesced work is not one event per client read. Idle denominators remain undefined.

panels.title: Average Racer-host CPU (non-idle)
panels.description: Mean non-idle fraction per host, then an equal-weight mean across discovered Racer hosts with CPU samples. Includes all host workloads and I/O wait, not just Racer. Missing host CPU series are not zero. System-only nodes are excluded by the Racer node join.

targets.expr: avg((1 - avg by (node) (rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node-exporter",mode="idle"}[5m]))) and on (node) group by (node) (up{job="kubernetes-pods",namespace="${namespace}",app_kubernetes_io_name="racer-dataplane"}))
